name: ICAR Emeritus Scientist Scheme
benefit:
> **Honorarium:**

- ₹50,000/- per month honorarium in addition to pension.
- Subject to provisions of the Income Tax Act.

> **Contingency Grant:**

- Up to ₹2,00,000/- per annum per scientist.
- Used for chemicals, glassware, books, stationery, laboratory assistance, and ministerial help.
- May be enhanced with approval based on the nature of research work.
- Can be used for domestic travel rela
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a scientist of repute from the National Agricultural Research System (NARS). - The applicant must hold or have held the position of Principal Scientist, Professor, or above in an eligible institution. - The applicant must be retiring within the next 12 months or must have retired within 1 year from the last working day of the notification month. - The applicant must not be more than 65 years of age at the time of application. - The applicant must have at least 5 research papers published in refereed journals during the last 5 years, or must have received a national/international award or recognition. - In the case of teachers, the applicant must have received a teaching excellence award or appreciation for outstanding teaching performance. - The applicant must submit a project of national importance that is a continuation of his/her previous work. - The applicant must demonstrate that an equally competent regular scientist is not available in the institution to undertake the proposed work. - The applicant must be willing to devote full time to the approved project and must not accept any other remunerative employment during the tenure. - The applicant must not receive financial assistance for the same work from any other source while availing benefits under this scheme.
